import math

class Point(int x, int y)
class Advance(Point point, bool arrived)

int isqrt(int value)
    if value < 2
        return value
    root := value
    following := (value + 1) / 2
    while following < root
        root = following
        following = (root + value / root) / 2
    return root

int squared_distance(Point first, Point second)
    dx := first.x - second.x
    dy := first.y - second.y
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

int scaled(int delta, int step, int length)
    return if delta >= 0 then delta * step / length else -((-delta) * step / length)

Advance advance(Point position, Point goal, int step)
    dx := goal.x - position.x
    dy := goal.y - position.y
    squared := dx * dx + dy * dy
    if squared <= step * step
        return Advance(goal, true)
    length := isqrt(squared)
    return Advance(Point(position.x + scaled(dx, step, length), position.y + scaled(dy, step, length)), false)

int damage_dealt(int hp, int power, int armor)
    return math.min(hp, math.max(1, power - armor))

class Effect()
    strength := 0
    remaining := 0
    source := -1

    bool active()
        return remaining > 0

    void .receive(int new_strength, int duration, new_source := -1)
        if new_strength > strength
            strength = new_strength
            remaining = duration
            source = new_source
        elif new_strength == strength
            remaining = math.max(remaining, duration)

    void .advance_time()
        remaining -= 1
        if remaining == 0
            strength = 0
            source = -1

class Projectile(int number, int tower, int target, Point position, Point aim, string targets, int power, int speed, int splash, int slow_rate, int slow_time, int burn_amount, int burn_time)
    bool .fly()
        if speed == 0
            return true
        movement := advance(position, aim, speed)
        position = movement.point
        return movement.arrived

import combat = "./combat.qui"
import grid = "./grid_map.qui"
import pathing = "./pathing.qui"
class EnemyType(string name, string symbol, string movement, int hp, int armor, int speed, int bounty, int lives, int regen, int split_into, int split_count)
    spawned := 0
    kills := 0
    leaks := 0
    damage := 0

class Group(int kind, int spawn, int count, int delay, int interval, int multiplier)
    int spawn_tick(int start, int released)
        return start + delay + released * interval

class Wave(int reward)
    Group[] groups := []

    int enemy_count()
        return [for group := groups[] then group.count].sum()

class Plans(EnemyType[] types, Wave[] waves)

int type_index(EnemyType[] types, string name)
    for: position < int(#types)
        if types[position].name == name
            return position
    return -1

Plans parse_waves(string[] lines)
    EnemyType[] types := []
    Wave[] waves := []
    for line := lines[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "enemy"
            types = types.append(EnemyType(fields[1], fields[2], fields[3], int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), int(fields[6]), int(fields[7]), int(fields[8]), int(fields[9]), type_index(types, fields[10]), int(fields[11])))
        elif fields[0] == "wave"
            waves = waves.append(Wave(int(fields[1])))
        else
            item := Group(type_index(types, fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), int(fields[6]))
            waves[-1].groups = waves[-1].groups.append(item)
    return Plans(types, waves)

class Enemy(int number, int kind, int multiplier, local EnemyType settings)
    int max_hp := settings.hp * multiplier / 100
    hp := max_hp
    string movement := settings.movement
    slow := combat.Effect()
    burn := combat.Effect()
    alive := true
    cell := grid.Cell(0, 0)
    next_cell := grid.Cell(0, 0)
    progress := 0
    point := combat.Point(0, 0)

    bool flying()
        return movement == "air"

    combat.Point position()
        if flying()
            return point
        return combat.Point(100 * cell.x + (next_cell.x - cell.x) * progress, 100 * cell.y + (next_cell.y - cell.y) * progress)

    grid.Cell occupied_cell()
        if flying()
            return grid.Cell((point.x + 50) / 100, (point.y + 50) / 100)
        return if progress < 50 then cell else next_cell

    int remaining(pathing.DistanceField field)
        return if flying() then combat.isqrt(combat.squared_distance(point, grid.cell_center(field.exit_cell))) else 100 * field.at(next_cell) + 100 - progress

    int slowed_speed(int base_speed)
        return if slow.active() then base_speed * (100 - slow.strength) / 100 else base_speed

Enemy split_child(Enemy parent, int number, int kind, EnemyType settings)
    child := Enemy(number, kind, parent.multiplier, settings)
    child.cell = parent.cell
    child.next_cell = parent.next_cell
    child.progress = parent.progress
    child.point = parent.point
    return child

import combat = "./combat.qui"

class Cell(int x, int y)

combat.Point cell_center(Cell cell)
    return combat.Point(100 * cell.x, 100 * cell.y)

class GridMap(int width, int height, string[] rows)
    exit_cell := Cell(0, 0)
    Cell[] spawns := []
    local found := array(9, fill = Cell(-1, -1))
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            terrain := rows[y][x]
            if terrain == "E"
                exit_cell = Cell(x, y)
            else
                match "123456789".find(terrain)
                    nat position
                        found[position] = Cell(x, y)
                    none
                        continue
    spawns = [for cell := found[] if cell.x >= 0 then cell]

    bool inside(Cell cell)
        return 0 <= cell.x < width and 0 <= cell.y < height

    string terrain_at(Cell cell)
        return rows[cell.y][cell.x]

    bool is_rock(Cell cell)
        return terrain_at(cell) == "#"

    bool is_water(Cell cell)
        return terrain_at(cell) == "~"

    bool buildable(Cell cell)
        return terrain_at(cell) == "."

GridMap read_map(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    dimensions := lines[0].split(" ")
    width := int(dimensions[0])
    height := int(dimensions[1])
    return GridMap(width, height, lines[1:<height + 1])

import math
import grid = "./grid_map.qui"
import pathing = "./pathing.qui"
import towers = "./towers.qui"
import foes = "./enemies.qui"
import combat = "./combat.qui"

string[] read_lines(string name)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + name))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

string one_decimal(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    rounded := (20 * numerator + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    return "{rounded / 10}.{rounded % 10}"

string digit(int count)
    return if count == 0 then "." elif count <= 9 then "{count}" else "*"

string[] ruled(string[][] rows)
    ruler := [for x := (0:<int(#rows[0]))[] then "{x % 10}"].join("")
    return ["  " + ruler].concat([for y := (0:<int(#rows))[] then "{y % 10} " + rows[y].join("")])

class Params(local string[][] rows)
    gold := int(rows[0][1])
    lives := int(rows[1][1])
    interest_rate := int(rows[2][1])
    interest_cap := int(rows[2][2])
    sell_rate := int(rows[3][1])
    start := int(rows[4][1])
    interval := int(rows[4][2])
    early := int(rows[5][1])
    int[] snapshots := [for value := rows[6][1:][] then int(value)]

class Action(int tick, string command, string[] arguments)

Action parse_action(string line)
    fields := line.split(" ")
    return Action(int(fields[0]), fields[1], fields[2:])

class WaveRecord(int number, int plan, int start, local int group_count, local int tower_count)
    end_tick := 0
    status := ""
    released := array(nat(group_count), fill = 0)
    spawned := 0
    peak := 0
    kills := 0
    leaks := 0
    lives_lost := 0
    bounty := 0
    reward := 0
    interest := 0
    gold := 0
    lives := 0
    tower_damage := array(nat(tower_count), fill = 0)

    bool all_released(foes.Wave schedule)
        for: position < int(#released)
            if released[position] != schedule.groups[position].count
                return false
        return true

    void .close(string end_status, int end_time, int end_gold, int end_lives)
        status = end_status
        end_tick = end_time
        gold = end_gold
        lives = end_lives

    string csv_row()
        fields := ["{number}", "{start}", "{end_tick}", status, "{spawned}", "{peak}", "{kills}", "{leaks}", "{lives_lost}", "{bounty}", "{reward}", "{interest}", "{gold}", "{lives}"]
        return fields.concat([for value := tower_damage[] then "{value}"]).join(",")

class Game(grid.GridMap terrain, towers.TowerType[] tower_types, foes.EnemyType[] enemy_types, foes.Wave[] waves, Params params)
    combat.Point exit_center := grid.cell_center(terrain.exit_cell)
    tick := 0
    int gold := params.gold
    int lives := params.lives
    towers.Tower[] built := []
    foes.Enemy[] creeps := []
    combat.Projectile[] projectiles := []
    projectile_count := 0
    WaveRecord[] records := []
    active := -1
    int next_start := params.start
    outcome := ""
    field := pathing.DistanceField(terrain, [])
    int[][] kill_counts := array(nat(terrain.height), fill = array(nat(terrain.width), fill = 0))
    income := array(5, fill = 0)
    spent := 0
    done := 0
    refused := 0
    string[] events := []
    string[] snapshots := []

    void .record(string body)
        events = events.append("{tick} {body}")

    int[] living_indices()
        return [for index := (0:<int(#creeps))[] if creeps[index].alive then index]

    int[] standing_indices()
        return [for index := (0:<int(#built))[] if built[index].standing() then index]

    grid.Cell[] tower_cells()
        return [for index := standing_indices()[] then built[index].cell]

    int tower_at(grid.Cell cell)
        for index := standing_indices()[]
            if built[index].cell == cell
                return index
        return -1

    int tower_index(string text)
        int index := int(text) - 1
        return if 0 <= index < int(#built) and built[index].standing() then index else -1

    int find_tower_type(string name)
        for: index < int(#tower_types)
            if tower_types[index].name == name
                return index
        return -1

    string build_refusal(string name, grid.Cell cell)
        int kind := find_tower_type(name)
        if kind < 0
            return "type"
        if not terrain.inside(cell)
            return "bounds"
        if not terrain.buildable(cell)
            return "terrain"
        if tower_at(cell) >= 0
            return "tower"
        if gold < tower_types[kind].levels[0].cost
            return "gold"
        int[] walkers := [for index := living_indices()[] if not creeps[index].flying() then index]
        for index := walkers[]
            if creeps[index].cell == cell or creeps[index].next_cell == cell
                return "enemy"
        trial := pathing.DistanceField(terrain, tower_cells().append(cell))
        for spawn := terrain.spawns[]
            if trial.at(spawn) < 0
                return "blocked"
        for index := walkers[]
            if trial.at(creeps[index].next_cell) < 0
                return "blocked"
        return ""

    bool .build(string[] arguments)
        name := arguments[0]
        cell := grid.Cell(int(arguments[1]), int(arguments[2]))
        string reason := build_refusal(name, cell)
        if reason != ""
            .record("BUILD_REFUSED {name} {arguments[1]} {arguments[2]} {reason}")
            return false
        int kind := find_tower_type(name)
        int cost := tower_types[kind].levels[0].cost
        defense := towers.Tower(int(#built) + 1, kind, cell, tick, cost)
        built = built.append(defense)
        for &wave := &records[]
            wave.tower_damage = wave.tower_damage.append(0)
        gold -= cost
        spent += cost
        .record("BUILD T{defense.number} {name} {cell.x} {cell.y} cost {cost} gold {gold}")
        .update_field()
        return true

    bool .upgrade(string[] arguments)
        int index := tower_index(arguments[0])
        reason := ""
        if index < 0
            reason = "notower"
        elif built[index].level == int(#tower_types[built[index].kind].levels)
            reason = "maxlevel"
        else
            int cost := tower_types[built[index].kind].levels[built[index].level].cost
            if gold < cost
                reason = "gold"
            else
                gold -= cost
                spent += cost
                built[index].level += 1
                built[index].investment += cost
                .record("UPGRADE T{built[index].number} level {built[index].level} cost {cost} gold {gold}")
                return true
        .record("UPGRADE_REFUSED T{arguments[0]} {reason}")
        return false

    bool .sell(string[] arguments)
        int index := tower_index(arguments[0])
        if index < 0
            .record("SELL_REFUSED T{arguments[0]} notower")
            return false
        rate := if tick == built[index].built then 100 else params.sell_rate
        refund := built[index].investment * rate / 100
        built[index].sold = tick
        gold += refund
        income[4] += refund
        .record("SELL T{built[index].number} refund {refund} gold {gold}")
        .update_field()
        return true

    bool .set_target(string[] arguments)
        int index := tower_index(arguments[0])
        mode := arguments[1]
        reason := ""
        if index < 0
            reason = "notower"
        elif not towers.valid_mode(mode)
            reason = "mode"
        else
            built[index].mode = mode
            .record("TARGET T{built[index].number} {mode}")
            return true
        .record("TARGET_REFUSED T{arguments[0]} {reason}")
        return false

    bool .call_wave()
        if active >= 0
            .record("CALL_REFUSED active")
            return false
        bonus := (next_start - tick) * params.early
        gold += bonus
        income[3] += bonus
        next_start = tick
        .record("CALL {#records + 1} bonus {bonus} gold {gold}")
        return true

    void .perform(Action action)
        succeeded := false
        if action.command == "BUILD"
            succeeded = .build(action.arguments)
        elif action.command == "UPGRADE"
            succeeded = .upgrade(action.arguments)
        elif action.command == "SELL"
            succeeded = .sell(action.arguments)
        elif action.command == "TARGET"
            succeeded = .set_target(action.arguments)
        else
            succeeded = .call_wave()
        if succeeded
            done += 1
        else
            refused += 1

    void .update_field()
        pathing.DistanceField previous := field
        field = pathing.DistanceField(terrain, tower_cells())
        for: number < int(#terrain.spawns)
            old_distance := previous.at(terrain.spawns[number])
            int new_distance := field.at(terrain.spawns[number])
            if old_distance != new_distance
                .record("REPATH {number + 1} {old_distance} {new_distance}")

    void .start_wave()
        index := int(#records)
        records = records.append(WaveRecord(index + 1, index, tick, int(#waves[index].groups), int(#built)))
        active = index
        next_start = 0
        .record("WAVE_START {index + 1} enemies {waves[index].enemy_count()}")

    void .add_enemy(foes.Enemy enemy)
        creeps = creeps.append(enemy)
        records[active].spawned += 1
        enemy_types[enemy.kind].spawned += 1

    void .spawn_enemies()
        if tick == next_start
            .start_wave()
        if active < 0
            return
        plan := waves[records[active].plan]
        for: position < int(#plan.groups)
            foes.Group group := plan.groups[position]
            int released := records[active].released[position]
            if released == group.count or group.spawn_tick(records[active].start, released) != tick
                continue
            records[active].released[position] += 1
            grid.Cell spawn := terrain.spawns[group.spawn - 1]
            enemy := foes.Enemy(int(#creeps) + 1, group.kind, group.multiplier, enemy_types[group.kind])
            if enemy.flying()
                enemy.point = grid.cell_center(spawn)
            else
                enemy.cell = spawn
                enemy.next_cell = field.next_cell(spawn)
            .add_enemy(enemy)
            .record("SPAWN E{enemy.number} {enemy_types[enemy.kind].name} {group.spawn} hp {enemy.hp}")
        records[active].peak = math.max(records[active].peak, int(#living_indices()))

    void .credit(int tower, int enemy, int damage)
        built[tower].damage += damage
        enemy_types[creeps[enemy].kind].damage += damage
        records[active].tower_damage[tower] += damage

    void .kill(int enemy, int tower)
        fallen := creeps[enemy]
        creeps[enemy].alive = false
        cell := fallen.occupied_cell()
        kill_counts[cell.y][cell.x] += 1
        bounty := enemy_types[fallen.kind].bounty
        built[tower].kills += 1
        records[active].kills += 1
        enemy_types[fallen.kind].kills += 1
        gold += bounty
        records[active].bounty += bounty
        income[0] += bounty
        .record("KILL E{fallen.number} {enemy_types[fallen.kind].name} T{built[tower].number} bounty {bounty} gold {gold}")
        for: child_number < enemy_types[fallen.kind].split_count
            kind := enemy_types[fallen.kind].split_into
            child := foes.split_child(fallen, int(#creeps) + 1, kind, enemy_types[kind])
            .add_enemy(child)
            .record("SPAWN E{child.number} {enemy_types[kind].name} E{fallen.number} hp {child.hp}")

    void .leak(int enemy)
        creeps[enemy].alive = false
        kind := creeps[enemy].kind
        lost := math.min(lives, enemy_types[kind].lives)
        lives -= lost
        records[active].leaks += 1
        records[active].lives_lost += lost
        enemy_types[kind].leaks += 1
        .record("LEAK E{creeps[enemy].number} {enemy_types[kind].name} lives {lives}")
        if lives == 0
            .record("DEFEAT")
            outcome = "defeat"
            .records[active].close("lost", tick, gold, lives)
            active = -1

    bool .walk(int index, int speed)
        &walker := &creeps[index]
        if terrain.is_water(walker.occupied_cell())
            speed = speed / 2
        while speed > 0
            rest := 100 - walker.progress
            if speed < rest
                walker.progress += speed
                speed = 0
            else
                speed -= rest
                walker.cell = walker.next_cell
                walker.progress = 0
                if walker.cell == terrain.exit_cell
                    return true
                walker.next_cell = field.next_cell(walker.cell)
        return false

    void .move_enemy(int index)
        &enemy := &creeps[index]
        if enemy.burn.active()
            int source := enemy.burn.source
            int damage := math.min(enemy.hp, enemy.burn.strength)
            enemy.hp -= damage
            .credit(source, index, damage)
            .enemy.burn.advance_time()
            if enemy.hp == 0
                .kill(index, source)
                return
        enemy.hp = math.min(enemy.hp + enemy_types[enemy.kind].regen, enemy.max_hp)
        speed := enemy.slowed_speed(enemy_types[enemy.kind].speed)
        if enemy.slow.active()
            .enemy.slow.advance_time()
        arrived := false
        if enemy.flying()
            movement := combat.advance(enemy.point, exit_center, speed)
            enemy.point = movement.point
            arrived = movement.arrived
        else
            arrived = .walk(index, speed)
        if arrived
            .leak(index)

    void .move_enemies()
        for index := living_indices()[]
            .move_enemy(index)
            if outcome != ""
                return

    void .fire(int tower, int target)
        &defense := &built[tower]
        kind := tower_types[defense.kind]
        towers.Level stats := kind.levels[defense.level - 1]
        projectile_count += 1
        projectiles = projectiles.append(combat.Projectile(projectile_count, tower, target, defense.center(), creeps[target].position(), kind.targets, stats.power, stats.shot_speed, stats.splash, stats.slow_rate, stats.slow_time, stats.burn_amount, stats.burn_time))
        defense.shots += 1
        defense.ready = tick + stats.interval
        .record("SHOT T{defense.number} E{creeps[target].number}")

    void .fire_towers()
        for index := standing_indices()[]
            if tick < built[index].ready
                continue
            target := towers.select_target(built[index], tower_types[built[index].kind], creeps, living_indices(), field)
            if target >= 0
                .fire(index, target)

    void .impact(combat.Projectile projectile)
        tower := projectile.tower
        int[] victims := []
        if projectile.splash == 0
            if creeps[projectile.target].alive
                victims = victims.append(projectile.target)
        else
            reach := projectile.splash * projectile.splash
            victims = [for index := living_indices()[] if towers.can_aim(projectile.targets, creeps[index]) and combat.squared_distance(creeps[index].position(), projectile.aim) <= reach then index]
        if #victims == 0
            built[tower].fizzles += 1
        for index := victims[]
            &enemy := &creeps[index]
            built[tower].hits += 1
            damage := combat.damage_dealt(enemy.hp, projectile.power, enemy_types[enemy.kind].armor)
            enemy.hp -= damage
            .credit(tower, index, damage)
            if enemy.hp == 0
                .kill(index, tower)
                continue
            if projectile.slow_rate > 0
                .enemy.slow.receive(projectile.slow_rate, projectile.slow_time)
            if projectile.burn_amount > 0
                .enemy.burn.receive(projectile.burn_amount, projectile.burn_time, tower)

    void .move_projectiles()
        combat.Projectile[] flying := []
        for projectile := projectiles[]
            if creeps[projectile.target].alive
                projectile.aim = creeps[projectile.target].position()
            if .projectile.fly()
                .impact(projectile)
            else
                flying = flying.append(projectile)
        projectiles = flying

    void .check_wave_end()
        if active < 0 or #living_indices() > 0 or not records[active].all_released(waves[records[active].plan])
            return
        &wave := &records[active]
        reward := waves[wave.plan].reward
        gold += reward
        interest := math.min(params.interest_cap, gold * params.interest_rate / 100)
        gold += interest
        wave.reward = reward
        wave.interest = interest
        income[1] += reward
        income[2] += interest
        .record("WAVE_END {wave.number} reward {reward} interest {interest} gold {gold}")
        if wave.number == int(#waves)
            .record("VICTORY")
            outcome = "victory"
        else
            next_start = tick + params.interval
        .wave.close("cleared", tick, gold, lives)
        active = -1

    void .run(Action[] script)
        position := 0
        while true
            tick += 1
            while position < int(#script) and script[position].tick == tick
                .perform(script[position])
                position += 1
            .spawn_enemies()
            .move_enemies()
            if outcome != ""
                break
            .fire_towers()
            .move_projectiles()
            .check_wave_end()
            for requested := params.snapshots[]
                if requested == tick
                    snapshots = snapshots.concat(block("SNAPSHOT"))
            if outcome != ""
                break
        snapshots = snapshots.concat(final_block())

    string[][] map_picture()
        picture := [for row := terrain.rows[] then [for x := (0:<terrain.width)[] then row[x]]]
        for spawn := terrain.spawns[]
            for cell := field.path(spawn)[]
                ground := terrain.terrain_at(cell)
                if ground == "." or ground == "~"
                    picture[cell.y][cell.x] = "+"
        for index := standing_indices()[]
            cell := built[index].cell
            picture[cell.y][cell.x] = tower_types[built[index].kind].symbol
        int[][] occupants := array(nat(terrain.height), fill = array(nat(terrain.width), fill = 0))
        for index := living_indices()[]
            cell := creeps[index].occupied_cell()
            occupants[cell.y][cell.x] += 1
            picture[cell.y][cell.x] = if occupants[cell.y][cell.x] == 1 then enemy_types[creeps[index].kind].symbol else "*"
        return picture

    string[][] flow_picture()
        string[][] picture := []
        arrows := "^>v<"
        for: y < terrain.height
            string[] row := []
            for: x < terrain.width
                cell := grid.Cell(x, y)
                ground := terrain.terrain_at(cell)
                int tower := tower_at(cell)
                symbol := ground
                if ground != "#" and ground != "E"
                    if tower >= 0
                        symbol = tower_types[built[tower].kind].symbol
                    elif field.at(cell) < 0
                        symbol = "?"
                    else
                        symbol = arrows[field.direction(cell)]
                row = row.append(symbol)
            picture = picture.append(row)
        return picture

    string[][] coverage_picture()
        string[][] picture := []
        int[] standing := standing_indices()
        for: y < terrain.height
            string[] row := []
            for: x < terrain.width
                cell := grid.Cell(x, y)
                int tower := tower_at(cell)
                symbol := "#"
                if not terrain.is_rock(cell)
                    if tower >= 0
                        symbol = tower_types[built[tower].kind].symbol
                    else
                        count := [for index := standing[] if built[index].in_range(grid.cell_center(cell), tower_types[built[index].kind].levels[built[index].level - 1].range) then 1].sum()
                        symbol = digit(count)
                row = row.append(symbol)
            picture = picture.append(row)
        return picture

    string[][] kills_picture()
        string[][] picture := []
        for: y < terrain.height
            string[] row := []
            for: x < terrain.width
                symbol := if kill_counts[y][x] > 0 then digit(kill_counts[y][x]) elif terrain.is_rock(grid.Cell(x, y)) then "#" else "."
                row = row.append(symbol)
            picture = picture.append(row)
        return picture

    string[] block(string label)
        next_text := if active < 0 and outcome == "" then "{next_start}" else "-"
        lines := ["{label} {tick} wave {#records} next {next_text} gold {gold} lives {lives}"]
        lines = lines.concat(ruled(map_picture()))
        for: number < int(#terrain.spawns)
            lines = lines.append("PATH {number + 1} length {field.at(terrain.spawns[number])}")
        for index := standing_indices()[]
            defense := built[index]
            lines = lines.append("T{defense.number} {tower_types[defense.kind].name} {defense.cell.x} {defense.cell.y} level {defense.level} mode {defense.mode} ready {defense.ready}")
        for index := living_indices()[]
            enemy := creeps[index]
            point := enemy.position()
            lines = lines.append("E{enemy.number} {enemy_types[enemy.kind].name} {point.x} {point.y} hp {enemy.hp}/{enemy.max_hp} slow {enemy.slow.strength} {enemy.slow.remaining} burn {enemy.burn.strength} {enemy.burn.remaining}")
        for projectile := projectiles[]
            lines = lines.append("P{projectile.number} T{built[projectile.tower].number} E{creeps[projectile.target].number} {projectile.position.x} {projectile.position.y}")
        return lines

    string[] final_block()
        return block("FINAL").append("FLOW").concat(ruled(flow_picture())).append("COVERAGE").concat(ruled(coverage_picture())).append("KILLS").concat(ruled(kills_picture()))

    string[] wave_lines()
        header := "wave,start,end,status,spawned,peak,kills,leaks,lives_lost,bounty,reward,interest,gold,lives"
        for defense := built[]
            header += ",T{defense.number}"
        return [header].concat([for wave := records[] then wave.csv_row()])

    string mvp_line()
        best := -1
        for: index < int(#built)
            if best < 0 or built[index].damage > built[best].damage
                best = index
        return if best < 0 then "mvp -" else "mvp T{built[best].number} damage {built[best].damage}"

    string tower_line(int index, int total_damage)
        defense := built[index]
        state := if defense.standing() then "active" else "sold {defense.sold}"
        return "TOWER T{defense.number} {tower_types[defense.kind].name} {defense.cell.x} {defense.cell.y} level {defense.level} mode {defense.mode} {state} shots {defense.shots} hits {defense.hits} fizzles {defense.fizzles} kills {defense.kills} damage {defense.damage} per_shot {one_decimal(defense.damage, defense.shots)} share {one_decimal(100 * defense.damage, total_damage)} invested {defense.investment}"

    string[] summary_lines(int action_count)
        cleared := [for wave := records[] if wave.status == "cleared" then 1].sum()
        perfect := [for wave := records[] if wave.status == "cleared" and wave.leaks == 0 then 1].sum()
        spawned := [for kind := enemy_types[] then kind.spawned].sum()
        killed := [for kind := enemy_types[] then kind.kills].sum()
        leaked := [for kind := enemy_types[] then kind.leaks].sum()
        total_damage := [for defense := built[] then defense.damage].sum()
        score := 10 * killed + 100 * lives + 50 * perfect + gold
        unused := action_count - done - refused
        string[] lines := ["outcome {outcome}", "ticks {tick}", "waves {cleared}/{#waves} perfect {perfect}", "lives {lives}/{params.lives}", "gold {gold}", "enemies spawned {spawned} killed {killed} leaked {leaked}", "income bounty {income[0]} reward {income[1]} interest {income[2]} early {income[3]} refund {income[4]}", "spent {spent}", "damage {total_damage}", "actions total {action_count} done {done} refused {refused} unused {unused}", "score {score}", mvp_line()]
        for kind := enemy_types[]
            lines = lines.append("ENEMY {kind.name} spawned {kind.spawned} killed {kind.kills} leaked {kind.leaks} damage {kind.damage}")
        for: index < int(#built)
            lines = lines.append(tower_line(index, total_damage))
        return lines

void run_game()
    terrain := grid.read_map("input/map.txt")
    towers.TowerType[] tower_types := towers.parse_types(read_lines("towers.txt"))
    plans := foes.parse_waves(read_lines("waves.txt"))
    actions := [for line := read_lines("actions.txt")[] then parse_action(line)]
    params := Params([for line := read_lines("params.txt")[] then line.split(" ")])
    game := Game(terrain, tower_types, plans.types, plans.waves, params)
    .game.run(actions)
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("events.txt", game.events)
    write_lines("waves.csv", game.wave_lines())
    write_lines("snapshots.txt", game.snapshots)
    write_lines("summary.txt", game.summary_lines(int(#actions)))

if main
    run_game()

import grid = "./grid_map.qui"

grid.Cell neighbor(grid.Cell cell, int direction)
    if direction == 0
        return grid.Cell(cell.x, cell.y - 1)
    if direction == 1
        return grid.Cell(cell.x + 1, cell.y)
    if direction == 2
        return grid.Cell(cell.x, cell.y + 1)
    return grid.Cell(cell.x - 1, cell.y)

class DistanceField(grid.GridMap terrain, local grid.Cell[] occupied)
    grid.Cell exit_cell := terrain.exit_cell
    int[][] distance := array(nat(terrain.height), fill = array(nat(terrain.width), fill = -1))
    local bool[][] blocked := array(nat(terrain.height), fill = array(nat(terrain.width), fill = false))
    for cell := occupied[]
        blocked[cell.y][cell.x] = true
    distance[exit_cell.y][exit_cell.x] = 0
    local queue := [exit_cell]
    local head := 0
    while head < int(#queue)
        current := queue[head]
        head += 1
        for: heading < 4
            following := neighbor(current, heading)
            if terrain.inside(following) and not terrain.is_rock(following) and not blocked[following.y][following.x] and distance[following.y][following.x] < 0
                distance[following.y][following.x] = distance[current.y][current.x] + 1
                queue = queue.append(following)

    int at(grid.Cell cell)
        return distance[cell.y][cell.x]

    int direction(grid.Cell cell)
        best := -1
        best_distance := 0
        for: candidate < 4
            following := neighbor(cell, candidate)
            if terrain.inside(following)
                int value := at(following)
                if value >= 0 and (best < 0 or value < best_distance)
                    best = candidate
                    best_distance = value
        return best

    grid.Cell next_cell(grid.Cell cell)
        return neighbor(cell, direction(cell))

    grid.Cell[] path(grid.Cell start)
        cells := [start]
        while cells[-1] != exit_cell
            cells = cells.append(next_cell(cells[-1]))
        return cells

import combat = "./combat.qui"
import grid = "./grid_map.qui"
import enemies = "./enemies.qui"
import pathing = "./pathing.qui"

class Level(int cost, int range, int power, int interval, int shot_speed, int splash, int slow_rate, int slow_time, int burn_amount, int burn_time)
class TowerType(string name, string symbol, string targets, Level[] levels)

TowerType[] parse_types(string[] lines)
    TowerType[] types := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#lines)
        header := lines[position].split(" ")
        count := int(header[4])
        Level[] levels := []
        for: 1 <= offset <= count
            int[] values := [for field := lines[position + offset].split(" ")[1:][] then int(field)]
            levels = levels.append(Level(values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5], values[6], values[7], values[8], values[9]))
        types = types.append(TowerType(header[1], header[2], header[3], levels))
        position += count + 1
    return types

bool can_aim(string targets, enemies.Enemy enemy)
    return targets == "both" or targets == enemy.movement

bool valid_mode(string mode)
    return mode == "FIRST" or mode == "LAST" or mode == "STRONGEST" or mode == "WEAKEST" or mode == "CLOSEST"

class Tower(int number, int kind, grid.Cell cell, local int tick, local int cost)
    level := 1
    mode := "FIRST"
    ready := tick
    investment := cost
    built := tick
    sold := 0
    shots := 0
    hits := 0
    fizzles := 0
    kills := 0
    damage := 0

    bool standing()
        return sold == 0

    combat.Point center()
        return grid.cell_center(cell)

    bool in_range(combat.Point point, int reach)
        return combat.squared_distance(center(), point) <= reach * reach

    int target_key(enemies.Enemy enemy, pathing.DistanceField field)
        if mode == "FIRST"
            return enemy.remaining(field)
        if mode == "LAST"
            return -enemy.remaining(field)
        if mode == "STRONGEST"
            return -enemy.hp
        if mode == "WEAKEST"
            return enemy.hp
        return combat.squared_distance(center(), enemy.position())

int select_target(Tower tower, TowerType kind, enemies.Enemy[] population, int[] living, pathing.DistanceField field)
    best := -1
    best_key := 0
    for position := living[]
        enemy := population[position]
        if can_aim(kind.targets, enemy) and tower.in_range(enemy.position(), kind.levels[tower.level - 1].range)
            key := tower.target_key(enemy, field)
            if best < 0 or key < best_key
                best = position
                best_key = key
    return best
